scope: Local consolidated StarLiz Coding correction pass

outcomes.result: Objective-specific local Review increased from six to 49 activities: all 40 Year 1 activities and nine introductory Python lessons. Both independent variations were verified. The other 391 still require permitted evidence-grounded explanation review; each unresolved objective is listed in the coverage file. No pending reviews were bulk-completed.

Execution success is distinct from task completion. Actual output, parsed constructs, executed function calls, independently inspected HTML/CSS and real click results determine completion. Editing clears stale completion.

HTML and CSS carry forward once; existing downstream drafts are retained. Browser-local drafts survive refresh and resume. Reset affects only the current file, including collision-safe scaffold IDs. Legacy serialized shapes are accepted. Work already lost under the old memory-only refresh behaviour cannot be recovered.

Discover introduces small explanations of actual example/starter syntax. Build, Practise and Debug retain contextual guidance. Coverage includes Python text/numbers/calls/assignment/blocks/functions/return, HTML tags/nesting/attributes/void elements, CSS rules/declarations/units and the actual JavaScript DOM/output/event/callback syntax. Writing still begins at Build.
Python metadata and parsed function definitions determine applicability. Genuine functions lessons retain the guide; Y11.13 does not. Main-lesson breakdowns use the actual lesson example.
Later CSS respects the 440–620px results-width control. Desktop/mobile checks passed. Visual inspection found and corrected the inherited grid-column rule that squeezed the mobile playground editor.

The exact development playground skips unrelated profile bootstrap. Production exclusion, request bounds, same-origin checks and rate limits remain. Real learner authentication, consent, entitlement and ownership gates remain.

Counts distinguish authored, environment-published and prerequisite-free activities. Dashboard cards require existing access, matching ownership, year eligibility and unlocked prerequisites/readiness. Original Understanding Loops remains separate from the 440 requirements.

Functional checks, changed-file lint, TypeScript and the direct Next.js build passed. Repository-wide lint retains 14 pre-existing errors and 10 warnings outside this correction pass. The npm build wrapper was blocked by Windows EPERM regenerating a loaded Prisma DLL; Next.js compilation used the unchanged existing client.

Existing approval and full-runtime commands generated a current development-only receipt after matching all 440 content hashes and the practical executor hash. Previous approvals were backed up. productionReady remains false.

additionalCorrections: The preview iframe now mounts after its trusted document identity exists, fixing blank previews in the actual app.
Code-explanation text has explicit contrast against the existing pale background.
